title: C++: Operator Overloading
description: Create a Complex number class with overloaded +, -, and << operators.

steps.title: Complex Number Operators
steps.description: Define a Complex class with double real, imag. Overload operator+ and operator- as binary operators. Overload operator<< for output. Test: (3+4i) + (1+2i) = (4+6i).
hints: Complex operator+(const Complex& other) const { return Complex(r+other.r, i+other.i); }
friend ostream& operator<<(ostream& os, const Complex& c) { os << c.r << "+" << c.i << "i"; return os; }
